title: Add private beta published-release verifier
summary: Add a post-publish verifier for GitHub Release assets in the private beta NSIS/updater lane.
reason: After workflow dispatch, operators need a repeatable check that the published GitHub Release contains the signed NSIS installer, updater signature, channel JSON, checksums, and release notes before sending the download link to beta testers.
behavior_before: Local preflight and bundle artifact checks existed, but there was no offline-testable or GitHub-backed verifier for the final published Release asset set.
behavior_after: Operators can validate published private beta GitHub Release metadata either from `gh api` or a saved release JSON fixture, including required assets and channel-specific release posture.
manual_validation: pytest tests/python/tooling/test_private_beta_published_release.py -q - initially failed on PowerShell scalar-vs-array asset selection (3 failed, 1 passed)
pytest tests/python/tooling/test_private_beta_*.py -q - not run because PowerShell did not expand the wildcard path for pytest
pytest tests/python/tooling -k private_beta -q - passed (17 passed, 145 deselected)
rollback_plan: Remove the published-release verifier script, tests, docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: This verifier must not download installers, publish releases, mutate GitHub releases, print secrets, or require real GitHub access for unit tests.
